content.rendered:
?

Job 22:28 MSG..You’ll decide what you want and it will happen; your life will be bathed in light.

Job 22v28 NLT
You will succeed in whatever you choose to do, and light will shine on the road ahead of you.

Job 22v28 NIV
What you decide on will be done, and light will shine on your ways.
?
You have “absolute” control over your day..

??Whenever you wake up and you don’t like what you see as probable outcome of your day, deal with it, because, Whatsoever you permit is permitted and whatsoever you refuse will not stay. God has bestowed on you and I the authority to change things. We have the authority to make things right when things are wrong with the power in God’s Word.
Stop waiting for things to change…everything is provoked by a move.

??When you perceive your day is going “south”? you can redirect it to head up “north”☝, and when you perceive it’s going to be a great day, you can make it better..

The decision is yours to make, and whatever, you permit stays.
If you permit what you don’t want through nonchalance, fear or ignorance, it will fester, it will grow until it becomes too difficult to handle for you. Deal with it at the tender stage. It must not be allowed to grow.

✔ Great things are yours for the asking today & may God exceed all your hearts desires in Jesus name ??
